from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,shutil,subprocess
root=Path("/Users/me/hamon/estate-401c5d17da79/uma-inheritance-205178f1")
spec=json.loads((root/"SOURCE-INPUT.json").read_text())
assert shutil.disk_usage(root).free>32*1024*1024
def gh(b): return hashlib.sha1(b"blob "+str(len(b)).encode()+b"\0"+b).hexdigest()
rows=[]; missing=[]
for e in spec["entries"]:
    data=None; origin=None
    for value in spec["donors"]:
        donor=Path(value); p=donor/e["path"]
        if p.is_file():
            b=p.read_bytes()
            if gh(b)==e["sha"]: data=b;origin=str(p);break
        if (donor/".git").exists():
            r=subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/git","-C",str(donor),"cat-file","blob",e["sha"]],capture_output=True,env=dict(os.environ,GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0"))
            if r.returncode==0 and gh(r.stdout)==e["sha"]:data=r.stdout;origin=str(donor)+" Git object "+e["sha"];break
    if data is None:missing.append(e);continue
    targets=["baseline","candidate"] if e["path"].startswith("packages/uma-sim-ui/") else ["producer-source"]
    for kind in targets:
        target=root/kind/e["path"];target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        with target.open("xb") as f:f.write(data)
        target.chmod(int(e["mode"],8)&0o777)
    rows.append({"path":e["path"],"mode":e["mode"],"gitBlob":e["sha"],"sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),"bytes":len(data),"origin":origin,"targets":targets})
result={"schema":"hamon.uma.source-copy.v1","canonicalCommit":spec["canonicalCommit"],"copied":rows,"missing":missing,"completeUiOnly":True,"gitAncestryInvented":False}
(root/"SOURCE-COPY.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({"copied":len(rows),"missing":missing,"freeAfter":shutil.disk_usage(root).free,"receiptSha256":hashlib.sha256((root/"SOURCE-COPY.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest()}))
